description.text:
The first release of the Pokémon Card ★VS series, on 19 July 2001, sold as three Leaders' Pokémon half decks: Grass and Lightning, Water and Fire, and Fighting and Psychic. Its cards are numbered to 141, with Rocket's Tyranitar as an extra card numbered 142/141. Every Pokémon in it is a Basic Pokémon, so a deck is ready to play as soon as it is opened, and they belong to the Gym Leaders and other trainers of Gold and Silver, who also get their own Technical Machines.

VS was the first Japanese release with a new card back close to the English one, meant to become a single design used worldwide. The old and new backs could be mixed in tournaments if the cards were sleeved. The set never came out in English.
